name: Delta
tagline: A C64-style shmup. Formations come. You shoot. Best score lives in the file.
description:
You are a little ship on the left. Waves of aliens come from the right in C64 Delta formations — lines, loops, rocks that scrape the hull. Three lives. The score sits in the corner.

On a phone the D-pad and FIRE sit under your thumbs. On a computer it is the arrows (or WASD) and the space bar. Tap or press space on the title to start.

An unofficial port of HTML5 Delta by Jake Gordon, MIT-licensed. The original title tune was a SID recording and is not in this copy — the formations are. Close it, come back: your best is still there.
